title: PreparedPackageV1
description: LLP 0413.001 §2 — the complete artifact set for one composition role. Package bytes are a pure function of the role's graph under the declared boundary (identity guarantee, §2.1): byte-stable across session shapes, and the produce generation travels ONLY in the envelope’s (role, packageRoot, producerGeneration) attestation triple (r7 / ibex 0056 §4.8), never inside these bytes. Canonical form: RFC 8785 JCS. Normative string bound is 4096 UTF-8 BYTES (maxLength below is the character-count approximation); the TS authority (packages/exact-devtools/src/prepared-composition-schema.ts) enforces bytes.

producerBinaryDigest.description: ibex 0056 §4.6/§4.8: the producing identity — must equal the envelope's producer identity (the package-side half of the step-3 generation-splice invariant, §4.1 #22). Produce-stable, so §2.1 byte-stability holds; the produce GENERATION deliberately stays out of package bytes (the envelope attestation triple is its only carrier).

records.description: Sorted by sourceId; one owner per SourceId (§2.2 partition).

hostBridgedDynamicImportEdges.description: §2.5 inventory: sorted (module, specifier); reasons from the closed two-member enum, derivable from this package's own graph facts only.

computedDynamicImportSites.description: Computed dynamic-import sites — never bound, host-bridged call-time (§1 non-goals).

carriers.description: Reserved: carrier binding belongs to the ibex §6 schema (per-package roots replacing the whole-publication digest inside package bytes). Empty in the dark exact-side model.

oneOf.description: Discriminated typed external reference (§2.3): structural, never inferred; legal only from the agent package toward app; exempt from local target-presence (resolved at union closure, the ibex stage).
